author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's breaking records everywhere, including at PlayStation.

The gaming giant has announced that GTA 6 is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes back 30+ years and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more than 39 million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far.
title: GTA 6 Players On PS5 Averaged 17+ Hours During First Weekend

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals, and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot, Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027, priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff below, showing the completed build alongside his box art.
title: Lego’s First Marvel Rivals Set Is A 495-Piece Tribute To The Game’s Most Adorable Terror

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Despite being used in advertising Leonida's dynamic weather, hurricanes are actually locked behind a secret mission in GTA 6. Be careful proceeding though, since after you witness your first hurricane, they can happen at any time, no matter what you're doing.

First of all, you'll need to head to a very heavily fortified apocalypse bunker in North Leonard County. In the map below, you can see the icon marking these buildings.
title: How To Unlock Hurricanes In GTA 6

Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming, and Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally.

Remote Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbo
title: How To Play GTA 6 On Your PC Or Phone Via Remote Play On Xbox

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 gets downright weird when you go off the beaten track, and one secret mission will see you travel to the bowels of hell to fight Beezleboss himself, Satan. This detour is worth it because you'll get cool cosmetics and a powerful shotgun, plus a nice little bump to your health. Here's how you can start this Doom-inspired mission in GTA 6.

How to go to Hell in GTA 6

You can find this mission in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, and it's generally recommended that you tackle it once you've gotten your bearings in Chapter 2 of GTA 6. You can access it with either Jason or Lucia, and you'll need to follow these steps to find it:
title: GTA 6: How To Go To Hell And Fight Satan

author: Dave Irwin
description:
You can go birdwatching in GTA 6. Seriously. You can put aside that life of crime and take up the rather harmless hobby of logging new birds. It's not just birds, as there are reptiles, mammals, and marine animals in every county of the state of Leonida. Some are exotic, others common, and even some non-native creatures that are just plain weird to see here.

Of course, you don't have to look for critters in GTA 6. Plenty of other side activities that aren't main missions are worth indulging in, such as finding all the WAiNK Sculptures and
title: All GTA 6 Animals And Wildlife Spawn Locations

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
There are hundreds of ATMs all over the world of Grand Theft Auto 6. To be fair, you’re not going to withdraw cash from them often, as it’s always better to keep money in your checking account or family savings account. So, if you don’t plan on withdrawing money, then perhaps you’d much rather steal it. Thankfully, you can do just that by using tow trucks and vans.

title: How To Tow Away And Steal ATMs In GTA 6

author: Joey Carr
description:
In Grand Theft Auto 6, a large emphasis is placed on Jason and Lucia working out and staying in shape. The better shape the characters are in, the higher their stats, which include health, stamina, and focus. So, if you want Jason and Lucia ready to fight enemies and run around Leonida, you need them in peak physical health.

The best way to do that in GTA 6 is by visiting a gym, which you might have seen at Jason's safehouse in Chapter 1. However, following the events of Chapter 1, you'll need a new gym. Unfortunately, they become fairly hard to come by, especially during the earlier parts of the game. To save you time looking around Leonida, we have a full list of every gym location in GTA 6 ready for you in the guide below.
title: All Gym Locations In GTA 6

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go online. From Xbox Live to Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft paywalled multiplayer on its platforms, but the company reportedly aimed to break down that barrier for its next-gen console, Project Helix.

According to Windows Central, Project Helix was conceived under the previous Xbox leadership team as the device that would bridge the divide between PC and console gaming. Like the Asus Xbox ROG Ally PC handhelds, the console is said to have an Xbox-inspired interface and full PC game support through storefronts like Steam. Because of that design decision, it's claimed it didn't make sense to continue with paid multiplayer, since that service is free for games purchased on PC platforms like
title: Xbox Project Helix Was Reportedly Designed To Make Online Multiplayer Free

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week, threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox build of GTA 6 that could be used to create an unofficial PC port of the game. The hacker originally promised to publicly drop the .exe file for this version of the game depending on whether their memecoin hit a certain market cap, and has been taunting publisher Take-Two Interactive for failing to prevent the game files from leaking online.

"Months of takedowns, subpoenas, and wallet-tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving," Cyberleek wrote in a now-removed post on Reddit, insisting they were "fighting anti-consumerism" in the video games industry with their actions and using crypto funds to work on a new project. title: GTA 6 Hacker Releases Full Xbox Build, And PC Modders Are Already Trying To Get It Running

author: Joey Carr
description:
The main story in Grand Theft Auto 6 actively pushes Jason and Lucia into a romantic relationship, even though the player can resist it, if they prefer. However, there are plenty of other side characters that players would like the chance to try to romance, and one character near the top of that list is Vicki.

Similar to Mandy, another potential romance partner in GTA 6, many find Vicki to be an attractive side character who plays a role in the main story. Narratively speaking, Vicki is more of a factor than Mandy, but she shows less romantic interest in either Jason or Lucia. Still, in a game where anything is possible, you might be wondering whether it's possible to romance Vicki in GTA 6.
